claims.claim: Ideal Topstar manual sewing machine available for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies a vintage sewing machine with front panel text reading “IDEAL TOPSTAR” and shows a foot pedal and power cord connected.

risks.risk: May not stitch properly (thread tension, needle timing, feed/transport).
risks.proof: A short test-run video showing it sewing a straight line on fabric with thread in place (including tension adjustment if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-tested/unknown working condition item.

risks.risk: Missing or worn internal parts (needle, presser foot, feed dogs, bobbin case/inner parts).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle area, presser foot, feed dogs, and bobbin case/inner compartment with the bobbin installed.

risks.risk: Controls may be faulty (speed control, reverse/lever functions, any dials).
risks.proof: Video showing the speed control changing smoothly and any reverse/lever function operating correctly.

risks.risk: Electrical/pedal condition may be unsafe or unreliable (cord/pedal wiring integrity).
risks.proof: Photo/clip of the pedal and cord showing no damage, plus a video of the machine powering and responding to pedal press.

risks.risk: Accessories/attachments may be missing (bobbin(s), bobbin winder, spare needles, feet/attachments).
risks.proof: Inventory photo showing all included accessories laid out (bobbin(s), winder, attachments, spare needles, manuals if any).

proof_requests: Send a test-run video sewing on fabric (straight stitch) with thread installed, showing tension and feed working.
Provide close-ups of the needle area, presser foot, feed dogs, and bobbin case/inner parts.
Show a video of the speed control and any reverse/lever functions operating.
Show clear photos of the pedal and power cord (no cuts/fraying) and a clip of the machine responding to pedal press.
List and photograph all included accessories/attachments (bobbin(s), bobbin winder, spare needles, any feet/attachments, manual if available).
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as an IDEAL TOPSTAR sewing machine and confirms it has a foot pedal and power cord, so it can be priced at a worst-case untested/unknown working condition. Key functional and completeness checks are not shown, so the price should reflect that risk.
